name: lightbox-grid

frames.best_why: The whole grid is visible with the large lake tile and five smaller nature photos.

tagline: Click a photo tile and it grows out of its slot into a full-screen view.
summary: A compact grid of rounded nature photos where the first tile spans four cells. Any thumbnail opens into a full-window viewer with arrows, a counter and a caption, and can be swiped or dragged back into place.
appearance: Six rounded photo tiles pack tightly on black, with one large landscape image filling a two-by-two square on the left and five smaller portrait and landscape photos beside it. The open view centres one photo on a dark backdrop, with a counter and close at top right, round arrows at the sides and a small caption below.
behaviour: Tapping a tile sends that same photo flying from its slot to the middle of the screen, growing and uncropping as it goes. Inside, a sideways swipe steps to the next photo, pulling down shrinks the image and flies it home, and Escape, arrows or the buttons close it.
demo_content: Six nature photos: a turquoise lake, peaks above clouds, misty hills, forest light, a sunset valley and a waterfall.
search_phrases: photo grid that opens a fullscreen viewer
click a thumbnail to zoom it
image gallery with swipe between photos
drag down to close a lightbox
full screen picture viewer with arrows
use_when: A page shows a handful of photos and each should open large without losing its place.
avoid_when: Large galleries: every photo mounts in the grid at once, so dozens of tiles mean dozens of image loads.
customise: The images array is the content prop; spacing, margins, spring timings and the grid shape are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Six photos plus motion springs during open and close; nothing runs while the grid is idle.

a11y.note: Tiles are labelled buttons, focus is trapped in the viewer, Escape and arrows work, and reduced motion skips the flight.

issues: Frame 1 opens on an empty stage before any tile has appeared.
polish_why: Clean grid with a convincing flight in and out; one sampled frame is completely blank.
